title: Connections adds guided examples and local evidence scopes
summary: The explorer now separates election reporting, surveys, ownership and public systems, with seven guided examples and a Harris County records pilot.
body: The Connections explorer includes seven source-qualified examples and plain-language descriptions of nodes, links, dates and evidence limits. Its sources remain available without using the visual graph.

The Harris County pilot separates 2021 acquisition and certification, documented November 2022 use, and a September 2026 state inventory. These records answer different questions and are not interchangeable.

USA TODAY coverage distinguishes historical AP-service and survey relationships from supplemental 2026 recruiting listings. Listings are research leads, not proof that contractors were deployed or that they supplied AP.
Reviewed-release comparison support is present but gated off until approved public releases exist. This update does not activate a research database or publish private drafts.
limitations: The linked commit documents a code change, not a deployment timestamp or a finding about election outcomes.

title: AP announces OpenAI as an election-data customer through 2028
summary: AP says the agreement covers U.S. vote-count data for national, state and major-city local elections through the 2028 general election.
body: In its May 27 announcement, the Associated Press identifies OpenAI as an election-data customer. AP describes providing vote-count data through the 2028 general election.

This is a data-supply relationship. It is separate from official election administration, certification and any particular cloud-hosting arrangement. The Connections explorer links the organizations to this specific announcement.
limitations: An issuer announcement establishes the stated agreement, not the backend used by a particular response or the accuracy of every AI-generated answer.

title: AP to provide Kalshi election data ahead of 2026 primaries
summary: AP announced an agreement to provide vote-count data and race calls for national and major state elections.
body: The Associated Press announcement identifies Kalshi as a customer for election vote-count data and race calls ahead of the 2026 primaries.

News race calls, market forecasts and certified election results are different products. The agreement describes election information supplied to a customer; it does not make a prediction market part of an official canvass.
limitations: The announcement does not establish AP control over Kalshi contracts or settlement, ownership of the market, or the hosting of its services.

title: AP announces U.S. network election-results customers
summary: ABC, CBS, CNN and NBC were announced as election-results customers for 2026 and beyond, alongside longstanding customer Fox News.
body: AP's October 15, 2025 announcement names ABC News, CBS News, CNN and NBC News as election-results customers beginning in 2026, joining Fox News.
The announcement says the networks retain independent race calls. Sharing a results provider is a documented customer relationship, not evidence that their editorial decisions are jointly controlled.
limitations: This is a 2025 announcement with a stated 2026 scope, not a new announcement on the date this brief was reviewed. It does not identify election-system ownership or vote-tabulation control.
